unresolvedCommentsBlocker.cause: GitHub branch protection 'Require conversation resolution before merging' is enabled and comment threads remain open.
unresolvedCommentsBlocker.uiResolution: Click 'Resolve conversation' on each open comment thread on PR conversation tab.
unresolvedCommentsBlocker.permanentRepoFix: In Repo Settings > Branches > main: Uncheck 'Require conversation resolution before merging'.

approvalBlocker.cause: GitHub branch protection 'Require approvals' is enabled.
approvalBlocker.cliResolution: node scripts/orchestrator/aegis-unblock-pr.js <pr_number> (submits APPROVE review via API)
approvalBlocker.permanentRepoFix: In Repo Settings > Branches > main: Set required approvals to 0 OR add Arslan / Gwynne to 'Allow specified actors to bypass required pull requests'.
